objects.name: Analytic 1835
objects.description: For Android, detect Disguise Root/Jailbreak Indicators by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate File Metadata via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: binary with file_permissions including setuid bit (mode & 04000) at path NOT IN $KnownSystemBinPaths$ — setuid outside system bin directories is the renamed-root-binary indicator]; Host Status via Android Enterprise DPC [DevicePolicyManager policy/compliance/security-state queries and SecurityLog events where supported]; Process Metadata via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: process executing with effective UID=0]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
